research.question: Blocker 0: Current official Ticimax documentation proves the WebSiparisFiltre and WebSiparisSayfalama member names. Research the remaining public API contract details for SelectSiparis: exact SOAP request wrapper name, exact parameter element names, exact XML namespaces, and namespace qualification of nested filter and pagination elements. Search current official Ticimax documentation, public SiparisServis WSDL/XSD references, and official SelectSiparis SOAP examples.

official_sources.observation: Opened live. The corporate page identifies Ticimax in its copyright and links destekalani.com as its support system, establishing the support site's official relationship.
Opened live. Its current-documentation section links the SiparisServis PDF on static.ticimax.com. It supplies SOAP examples for other operations, but contains no SelectSiparis example.
Opened the 42-page PDF through the official support page's documentation link. Section 4 documents SelectSiparis using parameter tables and C# examples; it does not establish its SOAP XML namespaces.
Opened live on Ticimax's official document host. This Ticimax service manual is labeled v1.4 and documents the SelectSiparis method signature on page 9.

claims.claim: The v1.4 manual explicitly names the method parameters UyeKodu, f, and s, but this alone does not prove their current SOAP element names.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/webservis.pdf — page 9 gives SelectSiparis(string UyeKodu, WebSiparisFiltre f, WebSiparisSayfalama s), with separate parameter descriptions for UyeKodu, f, and s.

claims.claim: The currently linked SiparisServis manual does not resolve the distinction between type names and serialized parameter names.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/SiparisServis.pdf — section 4, page 10, labels its parameter rows UyeKodu, WebSiparisFiltre, and WebSiparisSayfalama. These tables do not provide an XML request wrapper or namespace declarations.

claims.claim: Official examples establish namespace conventions for other operations, but cannot establish the exact SelectSiparis contract.
claims.evidence: https://www.destekalani.com/Icerik/ws-yetki-kodu-yonetimi-web-servis-modulu-649 — the SelectUrun example declares soapenv=http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/, tem=http://tempuri.org/, and ns=http://schemas.datacontract.org/2004/07/. Its wrapper and f/s parameters use tem; nested filter and pagination members use ns. No SelectSiparis example appears on this page.

unresolved: The exact SelectSiparis SOAP request wrapper local name and namespace were not verified from an accessible official WSDL/XSD or operation-specific SOAP example.
The current serialized parameter element names and namespaces remain unverified; the documented method signature suggests UyeKodu, f, and s but is insufficient wire-contract evidence.
Namespace qualification of SelectSiparis filter members, nested EntegrasyonParams members, and pagination members remains unverified.
Targeted searches found no official SelectSiparis SOAP example or accessible official SiparisServis XSD.

Public metadata retrieval attempts at https://www.noteshop.com.tr/Servis/SiparisServis.svc?wsdl, https://www.noteshop.com.tr/Servis/SiparisServis.svc?singleWsdl, and https://www.mooncorn.com.tr/Servis/SiparisServis.svc?wsdl returned browser Internal Error results. These hosts were not established as official Ticimax documentation publishers and were not used as contract evidence.
research.summary: Live official documentation supports the method signature and related SOAP conventions, but does not sufficiently prove the requested SelectSiparis XML contract. Blocker 0 remains unresolved.
